items.label: High Quality Material
items.value: This handbag for women is made of vegan leather (pu). No animals were harmed. Highly anti-scratch and tear-resistant, not easy to be out of shape.

items.label: Stylish Design
items.value: Detailed with high quality gold tone hardware, zippers, bottom studs, comfortable handles. Detailed with a decorative lock (not functional).

items.label: Functional Pockets
items.value: One main zipper compartment with one inner zipper pocket, one back zip pocket and two slot pockets. 2pcs: One large handbag + one wallet. Structured shape to make your stuff well organized.

items.label: Dimension
items.value: Approx. Size: 13.5" x 11.8" x 4.75". Can fit iPad, small tablet, A4 files, etc. / Clutch Size: 9"x 6" x 1”. Handle Drop Length: 6" / Come with an adjustable and removable shoulder strap.

items.label: Occasions
items.value: Perfect for everyday living, working, shopping, dating, traveling, vacation, etc. Nice Gift for families, wife, friends, parents.

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Avoid contact with harsh chemicals. Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

items.label: Origin
items.value: Made in the USA or Imported
